label: Scientism
resolution: Strong scientism has every claim to knowledge in scope, so its own formulation is in scope (STMT-SCIENTISM-IN-OWN-SCOPE) and the dilemma STMT-STRONG-SCIENTISM-DILEMMA applies. Weak scientism restricts the norm to a demarcated domain; whether its own formulation is inside that domain decides between the returning dilemma and the concession of non-empirical knowledge (STMT-WEAK-SCIENTISM-DEMARCATION-OUTCOME). No result infers anything about the weak thesis from the strong dilemma or conversely; STMT-WEAK-SCIENTISM-CONSISTENT shows the weak thesis survives. The comparative reading (most reliable source) is a third sense, not modeled. Exact-scope audit: STMT-STRONG-SCIENTISM is bound to generic ScopedScientism, so universal/all-established coverage is not built into its formal type. Explicit all-established, pointwise nonempirical and existential witness-transfer siblings now distinguish that scope; the exact nonempirical-negative alternative consumes the last bridge. The original strong/weak selfapplication results and their explicit own-scope premises are unchanged.
